tools.name: publish_post_to_linkedin_page
tools.description: Publishes a text post, with an optional link preview, to a LinkedIn company page that the connected account manages. The post goes live on LinkedIn right away.

params.name: organization_urn
params.description: LinkedIn organization URN of the page, e.g. 'urn:li:organization:123456'.

params.name: post_text
params.description: Body text of the post (max 3000 characters).

params.name: link_url
params.description: Optional URL to attach as an article link preview.

tools.name: purge_stale_post_drafts
tools.description: Runs the socialctl maintenance command to permanently delete unscheduled post drafts older than a given number of days for one brand workspace. Deleted drafts and their attached media cannot be recovered.

params.name: workspace_slug
params.description: Slug of the brand workspace whose drafts should be purged.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only drafts last edited more than this many days ago are deleted (minimum 7).

params.name: include_media
params.description: Also delete media files attached only to the purged drafts.

tools.name: offboard_workspace_collaborator
tools.description: Removes a collaborator from a brand workspace: their role and any channel publishing permissions are revoked, their API tokens are invalidated, and their unpublished personal drafts are deleted.

params.name: collaborator_user_id
params.description: User ID of the collaborator to remove.

params.name: delete_drafts
params.description: Whether to delete the collaborator's unpublished drafts. Defaults to true.

tools.name: reply_to_instagram_comment
tools.description: Posts a public reply to a comment on one of the brand's Instagram posts and records the reply in the community-management log so the comment is marked as handled.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Instagram Graph API ID of the comment being replied to.
